Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the context on NovaPay's payment support flows and the onboarding/chargeback examples. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- redwood-moderato-70B-instruct (higher-quality generations for agent-facing suggestions; prefer quantized v1 for cost)

Hi Elena / Rishi,

Quick summary from our smoke eval run (attached interim-eval-results.csv):

What we ran:
- 25 sample prompts provided by Elena.
- Two redaction strategies tested: token-replace ([CARD_LAST4]) and full removal.
- Models: lama-13b-q4f (our short name for redwood-llama-extended-13B-q4f), moderato-70b-instruct (quantized), and embedding+rerank baseline.

Top-line findings:
- lama-13b-q4f: best latency (p50 ~120ms) and solid template classification precision (~78%). Generates concise suggested replies but occasionally omits required remediation steps on longer system notes.
- moderato-70b-instruct: highest quality suggestions (precision ~89%) but about 3x cost and p50 latency ~420ms on our default config (can be tuned). Better at handling multi-sentence context and bilingual prompts.
- embedding+rerank: good fallback for templated matches but lower recall for paraphrased prompts.

Redaction impact:
- Replacing PAN segments with [CARD_LAST4] retained more signal for the models and improved template recall by ~6 percentage points vs full removal. No privacy leakage observed in the outputs given masked tokens.

Risks / quality regression notes:
- We saw two prompts where moderato produced factually incorrect statements about merchant policies (hallucination). We're flagging those and will include example prompts in the attached CSV.
- For worst-case long system notes (1.5k-2k tokens) both models needed chunking; moderate-quality dropoff observed if context trimming was aggressive.

Attachments & links we included:
- interim-eval-results.csv (per-prompt outputs, model chosen, error flags)
- prompt_set_template.csv (a recommended CSV template for the full prompt collection)
- Eval notebook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-eval-notebooks-novapay
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/NP-2026-001

Recommended next steps:
1) Elena: please upload the full prompt set in the attached prompt_set_template.csv format. Include a sample label for the desired agent template when possible.
2) Rishi / NovaPay: confirm whether token-replacement ([CARD_LAST4]) is acceptable as a redaction standard for the eval and for pilot usage.
3) We propose a short A/B (lama-13b baseline vs moderato-70b tuned) on a 500-prompt subset to validate production metrics (latency/cost/precision).

Happy to jump on the 1/21 call to walk through the CSV and flag examples — or we can reschedule for a narrower working session if you prefer.

Thanks,
